items.headline: JEE Main 2027 Session 1 form: last date to apply is Nov 22
items.summary: The last date is Nov 22 2026. A late fee of Rs 500 applies from Nov 23 to 26. The correction window is open from Nov 27 to 29.

items.headline: JEE Main 2027: NRI candidates can use passport as ID proof
items.summary: NTA has allowed NRI students to use their passport as identity proof while filling the JEE Main 2027 form.

items.headline: JEE Main 2027 and CBSE board dates unlikely to clash
items.summary: JEE Main Session 1 is in January. CBSE Class 12 board exams are expected in February and March 2027.

items.headline: KIITEE 2027 registration to open on Nov 10, reports say
items.summary: Careers360 and Shiksha report that the KIITEE 2027 Phase 1 form will open on Nov 10 2026 at kiitee.kiit.ac.in. The official KIIT notice is awaited.

items.headline: VITEEE 2027 exam window: Apr 27 to May 2 (tentative)
items.summary: VIT has shared a tentative exam window. Registration is open till Mar 31 2027. Slot booking opens in April.

items.headline: SRMJEEE 2027 dates out: only two phases this year
items.summary: Phase 1 exam on Apr 17 to 18 2027 (apply by Apr 2). Phase 2 exam on Jun 19 to 20 2027 (apply by Jun 4). Registration is open at srmist.edu.in; fee is Rs 1400 per phase.

items.headline: JEE Main 2027: NTA allows a fresh form to fix big errors
items.summary: Students with major errors can submit a fresh Session 1 form; only the latest paid form counts and the old fee is not refunded. Small errors can be fixed in the correction window, Nov 27 to 29 2026.

items.headline: NTA issues JEE Main 2027 registration advisory
items.summary: NTA shared key instructions for students filling the JEE Main 2027 form.

items.headline: JEE Main 2027 notification released; Session 1 registration open
items.summary: Session 1 registration is open on jeemain.nta.nic.in till Nov 22 2026. Session 1 exam on Jan 20 to 24 and Jan 28 2027.

items.headline: AEEE 2027 exam window set for Apr 15 to May 7
items.summary: Amrita has announced the exam window. Registration is expected to open in November 2026. There is no January phase this year.

items.headline: MET 2027 Phase 1 last date changed to Mar 15
items.summary: Manipal has moved the Phase 1 last date from Mar 31 to Mar 15 2027. Exam dates are awaited.

items.headline: NEET UG 2027 mode not final: CBT planned, pen-and-paper may stay
items.summary: The government has said NEET 2027 will move to computer-based mode, but Nov 2 2026 reports say pen-and-paper may continue as some states object. NTA has not issued an official notice yet.

items.headline: MHT CET 2027: both attempts likely after HSC boards
items.summary: News reports say the December attempt is dropped. CET Cell has not released the official schedule yet.

items.headline: BITSAT 2027 registration expected in December
items.summary: Two sessions are likely as in 2026. BITS Pilani has not released the official notice yet.
